title: Oozing Smoky Turkish Lamb Stew
description: A bold, slow‑cooked lamb stew with a smoky depth and a touch of sweetness from dried apricots, perfect for a hearty dinner.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium‑high heat and brown the lamb shanks on all sides.
Remove the lamb and set it aside.
Sauté the onion, garlic, and carrot in the same pot until the onion is translucent.
Stir in the smoked paprika, cumin, and smoked salt, cooking for 1 minute until fragrant.
Return the lamb to the pot and add the diced tomatoes, tomato paste, chicken broth, and apricots.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 120 minutes.
Stir in fresh thyme, season with salt and pepper to taste, and let the stew rest for 10 minutes before serving.
Serve hot, ideally with a side of fresh cucumber salad.
